extraction.notes: 2027 Carson Springs Student Camp dates and pricing are posted. No dated group-registration opening was found. The parent page says individual registration opens Spring 2027, without a specific month or date. A page titled Camp Prep - Testing gives April 1; that testing-page date was not used. The general Find a Camp page says entering grades 6-12, while the Carson Springs page and Student Camp FAQ say entering grades 7-12. No 2027 Kids Camp at Carson Springs was found; the Tennessee overview specifies kids camp at Linden Valley only. The camp-prep and day-camp URLs returned no readable text.

cards.name: Student Camp at Carson Springs
cards.description: Campers participate in staff-led worship, Bible studies, church-group discussions, and supervised indoor and outdoor activities.

hours.text: Arrival times are on the first day of camp between 2:00 and 4:00 PM in 10-minute windows. All student camp groups must depart by 9:00 am the last day of camp.

lunch.text: Meals are prepared on property and included for all guests.

cards.review_notes: Confirm grade eligibility: the general Find a Camp page says entering grades 6-12, but the Carson Springs-specific page and Student Camp FAQ state entering grades 7-12. The card uses the program-specific range. Registration is organized through church groups; individual participant registration is separate. Availability reflects the official CORE listing's two open Bunkhouse spots.
